metadata.title: World Digest — November 24, 2026
metadata.summary: Daily Summary Democrats clinched their largest House majority since 1990, while chip stocks tumbled on Nvidia's losses and Anthropic shares sank below their IPO price.

sections.title: Major Events
sections.content:
Democrats Clinch Largest House Majority Since 1990

Democrats secured at least 259 House seats, their biggest majority in decades, after flipping a North Carolina seat AP News.

Severe Thanksgiving Storms Threaten Millions of Travelers

Powerful storms could disrupt travel for over 250 million Americans and potentially ground Macy's parade balloons NBC News Yahoo.

DOJ Announces Largest-Ever Anti-Scam Crackdown

The Justice Department recovered $8 billion and charged over 800 defendants in its biggest fraud sweep Fox News.

Cartagena Hostage Crisis Unfolds in Colombia

Armed men took hostages at a supermarket in a top tourist destination after a failed armored car hijacking NBC News.

Shanghai Party Chief Detained in Corruption Probe

Chen Jining, a Politburo member once seen as a potential leader, is under investigation, intensifying Xi Jinping's purge AP News.

sections.title: Political News
sections.content:
Global Politics

China's purge deepened as Shanghai party chief Chen Jining became the fourth Politburo member investigated since 2025 AP News. Bangladesh's ousted leader Sheikh Hasina plans to return from exile on December 16 AP News, while Russia detained Murmansk Governor Andrei Chibis in a rare corruption case BBC.

US Affairs

The Pentagon sharply criticized Canada's military spending and F-35 review PBS, as a former aide demanded Defense Secretary Hegseth's resignation The Independent. Senate Democrats probed Vice President Vance's reported role in a Venezuelan oil contract Bloomberg.com, and Congress prepared to scrutinize Jensen Huang's Nvidia reinstatement Politico.

Regional Developments

Houthi drone attacks on Riyadh injured 11 Al Jazeera, while Iraq's PM moved to seize Kurdish-controlled oilfields Reuters. Denmark's Supreme Court upheld its hardline "ghetto law" DW.com.

sections.title: Financial News
sections.content:
Markets Slide as Chip Woes Deepen

Global chip stocks fell, pressuring the Dow, S&P 500, and Nasdaq futures Yahoo Finance. Micron dropped after a BNP Paribas downgrade warning of 2028 supply risks Stocktwits. Anthropic shares closed below their $83 IPO price, losing nearly $200 billion in value Reuters. Dell beat earnings estimates on AI server demand, authorizing a $25 billion buyback CNBC.

Retail & Consumer

Best Buy posted its best sales growth in five years Yahoo Finance. Consumer confidence hit a two-year high Reuters. Thanksgiving dinner prices reached an all-time high Fox Business.

Corporate & Policy

Sanofi agreed to buy Insmed for $41 billion Financial Times. New York banned AI toys NBC News. FAA is investigating an Amazon drone crash ABC7 New York.

sections.title: Tech News
sections.content:
GTA VI Shatters Records, Dominates Industry

Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto VI earned $3.79 billion in day-one retail sales, the biggest launch in PlayStation history The Guardian. The launch crushed competitors, with Call of Duty losing nearly half its player base IGN. However, the digital-only title, priced up to $100, can't be resold, and Take-Two blocked a major PC recompilation project Yahoo TechPowerUp.

Google Patents Personalized AI TV

A Google patent application reveals plans for a 24-hour "personal channel" featuring AI-generated shows starring viewers Gizmodo.

Samsung Cuts Camera Feature for AI

The Galaxy S27 Ultra reportedly drops laser autofocus and a 3x camera in favor of AI features Notebookcheck.

GTA VI Hacker Sentenced

The hacker behind early GTA VI leaks received a seven-year sentence and was released the same day The Verge.

sections.title: Entertainment News
sections.content: Disney’s Hexed premiered to mixed reviews, with Deadline praising its edgy YA fantasy while The Guardian called it a “wicked disappointment.” Deadline Netflix acquired Radford Studios for $380 million, a major California investment. Deadline The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping dominated the box office with a record Monday and $120 million debut. Deadline Meanwhile, Amazon renewed The Rings of Power for Season 4. Variety

sections.title: Sports
sections.content:
Football

  • Washington Commanders 22, Cincinnati Bengals 20 — Jayden Daniels rallied the Commanders in the final seconds to set up the winning kick ESPN.

Basketball

  • Milwaukee Bucks 116, Toronto Raptors 111 — Tyler Herro’s 32 points snapped the Bucks’ 13-game losing streak ESPN.
  • Portland Trail Blazers 128, Philadelphia 76ers 111 — Deni Avdija scored 31 with five 3s, handing the 76ers just their fourth loss ESPN.
  • San Antonio Spurs 123, Sacramento Kings 107 — Stephon Castle (28 points) kept the Spurs unbeaten on the road without Wemby ESPN ESPN.

Hockey

  • Ottawa Senators 2, Calgary Flames 1 — Linus Ullmark’s 34 saves powered the win ESPN.
  • Toronto Maple Leafs 4, New York Islanders 2 — Gavin McKenna scored to end Toronto’s nine-game skid ESPN.

Baseball

  • Japanese righty Kaima Taira agreed to a five-year, $80M deal with the Blue Jays ESPN.

sections.title: Music Releases
sections.content:
Albums & EPs

  • TOMORROW X TOGETHER — PERFECT STORM (Member Vers.) — Five solo editions of the K-pop quintet's album arrive simultaneously, spotlighting Taehyun, Beomgyu, Soobin, Hueningkai and Yeonjun [8–12].
  • Grand Theft Auto VI — The Album (Deluxe Edition) — The gaming juggernaut expands its soundtrack to 57 tracks, a week after the original 34-track release Spotify Spotify.
  • Gracie Abrams — Daughter from Hell (Deluxe) — The deluxe cut broadens her recent album with additional tracks Spotify.
  • Tom Waits — Orphans: Bastards / Brawlers / Bawlers — The trilogy returns across three volumes, spanning his eclectic detours [48–50].

Singles

  • RESCENE — Magic — The K-pop girl group returns with a new single Spotify.
  • Wegz — Diaa Diaa (from Leila Bazet Khales) — The Egyptian rapper contributes to the film's soundtrack Spotify.
  • Lauta, Nico Valdi, Phontana — Te Felicito — A multilingual collaboration across Italian and Latin pop scenes Spotify.

sections.title: Stock Analysis
sections.content:
IPOs

Recent listings include ProShares Ultra/UltraShort Anthropic (ANTU/ANTY) on Nasdaq Nov 23 Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance and Quantum Space (QSPC) on NYSE Nov 24 Yahoo Finance. No pricings were set.

Major Indices

The S&P 500 fell 0.50% to 7,201.09, while the Dow gained 0.85% to 50,018.70 Yahoo Finance. The Nasdaq dropped 1.48% to 23,733.54 Yahoo Finance. The Russell 2000 rose 0.57% Yahoo Finance. The VIX slipped 0.98% to 26.36 Yahoo Finance.

Sectors

Health Care led, up 2.95% Yahoo Finance. Energy and Consumer Staples also gained Yahoo Finance. Technology lagged sharply, down 3.26% Yahoo Finance.

Major Stocks

Nvidia fell 5.86% to $155.38, and Broadcom dropped 3.98% Yahoo Finance. Apple rose 1.43%, while Microsoft gained 0.74% Yahoo Finance.

Notable Movers

Amentum (+20.1%), Abercrombie (+19.7%) and Kohl's (+19.5%) led gainers Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance. Dycom (-18.0%) and Analog Devices (-17.4%) led losers Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance. Nvidia was most active Yahoo Finance.

Rates & Commodities

The 10-year yield fell 0.28% to 4.90 Yahoo Finance. Oil rose 1.63% to $81.48 Yahoo Finance. Gold dropped 2.58% to $3,557.20 Yahoo Finance. Bitcoin fell 2.08% to $59,939.78 Yahoo Finance.

sections.title: Outlook
sections.content:
24–48 Hours

  • Markets: Chip-sector volatility likely persists as Anthropic trades below IPO price and Nvidia slides; monitor whether tech weakness broadens.
  • Weather: Thanksgiving storms may disrupt travel for 250M+; possible parade cancellations and retail-impact signals.

Next Week

  • Colombia: Cartagena hostage crisis resolution could affect tourism and regional stability.
  • China: Chen Jining probe may signal further Politburo purges.

Next Month

  • GTA VI ripple effects: digital-only model may reshape industry resale and pricing norms.
  • Bangladesh: Hasina's December 16 return could trigger political unrest.

theme.note: A power shift and a chip crash mark the day, logged in ballot-blue ink on a bright news-paper sheet.
